method: CPU-only exact voxel-union boundary meshes in the source scan affine. Use pinned integer-mask labels 33-36, compiled source bounds plus one-voxel margin, memory-mapped NIfTI payload, vectorized link topology audit, no smoothing/interpolation/decimation or semantic regrouping.

predictions_before_source_run.topology: Report every edge incidence and vertex-link result as observed; no topology repair.

purpose: Generate source-bound geometry candidates for all remaining scan-001 soft-tissue labels: combined skeletal muscle, subcutaneous fat, torso fat, and psoas.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: Any identity, label-count or occupancy-volume failure is retained as a failed run.
Do not reinterpret subcutaneous fat as skin or the combined skeletal-muscle label as individual muscles/tendons/fascia; no subject binding, mechanics, physiology or clinical promotion.
